# Codename Sanskruti by Motwani Construction

> Codename Sanskruti is a premier temple-inspired luxury residential housing development by Motwani Construction located near Uttara Square, Bhubaneswar, Odisha.

## Project Summary
- Developer: Motwani Construction
- Location: Siula, near Uttara Square, Beside NH 316, Bhubaneswar, Odisha
- Configurations: 2 BHK, 3 BHK, and 4 BHK Luxury Apartments
- RERA Registration: RP/26/2026/01587
